items.title: Max-severity flaw in ChromaDB for AI apps allows server hijacking
items.description: A max-severity vulnerability in the latest Python FastAPI version of the ChromaDB project allows unauthenticated attackers to run arbitrary code on exposed servers. [...]

items.title: UAC-0184 Malware Chain Uses bitsadmin and HTA Files for Gated Payload Delivery
items.description: A newly documented attack chain linked to the threat group UAC-0184 has been observed using Windows’ built-in bitsadmin tool and HTA files to sneak malicious payloads onto targeted systems. The campaign is primarily aimed at Ukraine, with clear indicators pointing toward military-related targets, including individuals connected to the Ukrainian Defence Forces. items.title: Verizon DBIR: Enterprises Face a Dangerous Vulnerability Glut
items.description: Verizon's "2026 Data Breach Investigations Report" ("DBIR") finds that exploits are now involved in 31% of initial access for breaches, while patching lags too far behind the bad guys.

items.title: macOS Malware Installs Fake Google Software Update LaunchAgent for Persistence
items.description: macOS users are facing a new and sophisticated threat as a variant of the SHub infostealer malware, dubbed “Reaper,” has been observed deploying a fake Google Software Update LaunchAgent to maintain persistent access on infected machines. items.title: Cybercrime service disrupted for abusing Microsoft platform to sign malware
items.description: Microsoft says it has disrupted a malware-signing-as-a-service (MSaaS) operation that abused the company's Artifact Signing service to generate fraudulent code-signing certificates used by ransomware gangs and other cybercriminals. [...]

items.title: Windows Zero-Day Barrage Continues After Patch Tuesday
items.description: YellowKey, GreenPlasma, and MiniPlasma add to the growing list of vulnerabilities a security researcher disclosed over the past six weeks.
